clips.title: The story
paras: Cold Hearth Manor is a blighted farmstead located just west of Brill along the main road of Tirisfal Glades. Once a bustling, hospitable estate known for bountiful crops, the outbreak of the Plague of Undeath wiped out its residents, leaving the surrounding fields choked with mindless Scourge. Today, the Forsaken have secured the main farmhouse as an outpost and waystation for travelers.

Before the Third War, this homestead bore a reputation for warmth and hospitality, supporting rich harvests in the heart of Lordaeron. When the Plague swept through the kingdom, the entire family and their laborers succumbed, rising again as husks bound to the Scourge. While feral undead still stumble through the ruined fields, Forsaken forces managed to push the mindless dead out of the main farmhouse, reclaiming the structure to serve as a trading post and foothold along the road toward the eastern glades.
